| Assam Breakfast, malty, full-bodied black tea | Product/flavour fact, fine as written |

| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted |
| "100g tin" | Product size, fine as written |
| "makes around 40 cups" | Brewing fact, fine as written. "Around" keeps it soft. |

**Slop check:** No banned words, no em-dash sandwiches, no exclamation points, no rhetorical opener, no fake urgency. The first sentence is just the product name, which is fine for a product page.

**Other checks:** No superlatives, guarantees, testimonials, health claims or green claims beyond the certified organic one, which is backed. No affiliate or sponsorship issue.

One optional note: if the "40 cups" figure comes from a specific brew (for example 2.5g per cup), make sure it matches the brewing instructions on the same page. It isn't a blocker.

Nothing needs changing.
